gates.purpose: Verify user, task, product truth, constraints, desired perception, and open creative space are represented.
gates.pass: all required fields present; material low-confidence ambiguity is resolved or escalated

gates.purpose: Verify operational documentation explains representative renders and code evidence.
gates.pass: representative Surfaces can be explained without inventing undocumented rules

gates.purpose: Remove Directions that fail product truth, constraints, state support, responsiveness, or system potential.
Select among eligible Directions by blind pairwise comparison.
gates.pass: clear winner or explicit human decision

gates.purpose: Detect broken token references, conflicting Locks, incomplete component states, and schema errors.
gates.pass: zero errors; warnings accepted or resolved

gates.purpose: Verify build, typecheck, targeted tests, runtime, and console health.
gates.pass: required commands succeed and no unaccepted runtime error exists

gates.purpose: Find visual values outside canonical tokens or approved exceptions.
Verify existing components and accessible primitives were queried before new ones were created.
gates.pass: new components have a recorded resolution and no unjustified duplicate exists

gates.purpose: Detect overflow, clipping, collisions, unstable viewport sizing, and failed reorganization.
gates.pass: all required viewports and states satisfy assertions

gates.purpose: Combine automated checks with keyboard, focus, semantics, motion, and manual review.
gates.pass: zero critical/serious unaccepted violations and manual checks pass

gates.purpose: Verify required loading, empty, error, permission, long-content, disabled, and success states.
gates.pass: every required state is reproducible and captured

gates.purpose: Blindly judge product fit, hierarchy, specificity, composition, typography, coherence, responsiveness, and craft.
gates.pass: no blocker and threshold for Surface class is met

gates.purpose: Compare candidate against frozen Baseline without revealing which is new.
gates.pass: candidate wins or trade-off is explicitly accepted

gates.purpose: Verify approved status, provenance, required Gates, destination scope, and Lock compatibility.
